title: Page 7
content_zh:
“唉，大嫂你不要想那么多。来来，给我几张，我明天就问好数量然后自己去拿。”阿丰抢过她手中的传单。“剩下的都给我，我去帮你发。”
“阿——”
然而乔若曦话还没讲完，传单就都被阿丰拿走了。
“大嫂，明天早上我会打电话给你。”说完，摆摆手，阿丰一溜烟的离开了。
“老大，便当。”
褚天阔不是很在意的看了眼阿丰送上来的便当。现在对他来说，吃东西只是为了填饱肚子。
以前那种每天中午期待着某人的出现，怀着幸福的感觉
也许那真的是一场梦，他以为拥有过的东西其实并不存在。
现在只是醒了，回到以前的生活而已。
“老大，这家便当是我们第一次订喔！你看好不好吃。”
阿丰的多言让他皱眉。“随便，这种小事不要来烦我。”
“呃……是。”
褚天阔的脸却在
这摆放的方式、青菜的色泽，还有谁会在这种顶多七、八十块的便当里放烤牛排当主菜的？
“老大，怎么样？你还喜欢吗？”
褚天阔脸色陡变，抬头厉声问：“这是怎么回事？”
“大嫂——呃，我是说乔小姐，那天我在银行碰到她，她说她现在开始做便当的生意，我想说帮帮她……”
褚天阔咬着牙根，不说一句话。
他沉下脸的样子看起来很吓人，一时猜测不出他的心意，阿丰只能缩缩脖子说：“对不起，老大，你不高兴的话，我以后不会再跟她订便当了。”
“不！”褚天阔立刻吼道，然后觉得自己反应过头，冷静了一下才抿着嘴说：“你还是跟她订，不过以后不要买我的份。”

“老大你不喜欢喔？”
“罗唆！”他又吼了声。
“是。”阿丰偷偷看了褚天阔一眼。老大似乎还是很关心大嫂的嘛！就不知道他们俩是在闹什么别扭。
“那老大你慢用，我出去了。”他随即离去。
只剩下褚天阔一人在办公室里，看着眼前诱人的便当，他忍不住夹起牛排咬下一口咀嚼，阿丰怀疑他不喜欢，他怎么可能不喜欢。味道太好，好到让他心烦意乱。
下一秒，他咒骂一声，推开椅子站了起来。
够了！他不要再想她了！
男子汉大丈夫有什么好放不下的，不过是个不爱他的女人。
撇开眼不再看那个便当，他离开办公室，大步走进工地中。现在他得做点什么让自己忙碌，忙碌到脑袋自动停摆。
“老大！小心！”
耳朵听到有人惊慌的大吼，可是等褚天阔回过神来的时候已经来不及了。脑袋乱烘烘的他竟没有看清楚前方的路况，一个踩空掉进两层楼高的地下室。
“老大！”
几个兄弟跟工人往他的方向冲过去。
褚天阔只觉得全身剧痛，胸口像被巨石堵住，开不了口。该死！自己在工地做事那么久了，怎么会出这种错？
“老大！你怎样了？”
“我们打电话叫救护车了！”
“哎哎——不要移动老大！骨折不能乱动的！”
身旁是七嘴八舌的吵闹声，褚天阔咬牙忍耐一阵阵疼痛，想到他得在手下面前表现出这种孬样就呕得要命。
只因一个女人就让他整个人像失了魂似的，真是够了！
救护车来了，光是把他搬到担架上的折腾就让他汗水涔涔，失血让他眼前一阵晕眩。

“对了，得赶快通知大嫂！”不知道是谁突然大声叫着。
“不准——”
咬牙切齿，费尽全身力气说出这句话之后，楮天阔被送上了救护车。
接到消息匆匆赶到医院的乔若曦，在看到褚天阔紧闭着眼睛从手术室里被推出来的时候，差点虚脱倒地。
左手骨折跟多处挫伤，已经算是不幸中的大幸，可是看到病床上的他那一圈圈的绷带，她的眼泪还是止不住的往外流。
一定很痛吧？
她的手颤抖的抚摸他的绷带，心狠狠的发疼。
他高大的身子虽然躺在病床上，却一点也不显得虚弱。棱角分明的脸孔跟黝黑的皮肤，都是她所熟悉却好久不曾见到的。
虽然很想待在他身边，一直看着他、陪着他，可是乔若曦不想要是在这种情况之下啊！
突然，床上的人拧紧了眉，随后张开眼。
“你醒了！太好了！现在觉得怎么样？”
褚天阔眯起眼看着眼前的乔若曦。她红肿的眼睛跟鼻头显示才刚哭过，她那焦急难过的模样，让他下意识想要把她搂进怀中安慰，告诉她没事了。
然而回过神，他才想起他们已经结束了。
他硬生生压下要抬起的手。“你在这里做什么？”
“我……”乔若曦眨着泪眼。
“请你离开。”
“你受伤了，刚开完刀，我想照顾你。”
“不用了，你走。”他冷声道。
这又是她的报答吗？以前是当他的女朋友，现在是照顾受伤的他。这种报答他已经受够了。
他一点都不想要。

“可是……”
“我叫你走！”
被他这么一吼，她整颗心都碎了。“嗯……对不起，你保重。”
低着头，含着不想被他看到的泪水，乔若曦狼狈的走出病房。
她身后的褚天阔则一脸阴霾。
乔若曦手里提着保温壶，里面装着她一大早就起来炖的鸡汤。这碗汤不容易做，一边要注意火候，一边还要不时过滤掉杂质跟多余的油花。
鸡汤应该对病人很有帮助。她一心只想着这个，却没有想到她该怎么拿去给他。
快十一点时她兴匆匆的来到医院，却被挡在病房门外。
“大嫂，对不起。”
看到阿丰那带着歉意的表情，她的心沉了沉。“我只是想拿鸡汤给他喝。”
阿丰搔搔头，还是只有苦笑。
她咬着下唇。“那么……可以帮我拿给他吗？他刚开完刀，应该补充点营养，这鸡汤我熬了很久。”
听了她的话，阿丰脸上全是为难。
“大嫂你还是回去吧。老大现在受了伤，脾气也更暴躁，所以还是顺着他一点好。你放心，我会好好照顾老大的。”
乔若曦低下头。
她知道阿丰说的有道理，他其实也不需要她照顾，但她只是想看看他，想尽一点力量……
她没有想到他对自己的抗拒会那么深。
“嗯。”
勉强对阿丰挤出一点笑容，她沮丧的转身，抱着显得更沉重的保温壶回去。
第8章(2)

走向电梯的时候，她听到高跟鞋踩在地板上清脆的声音，然后她的肩膀撞到一个人，手上的保温壶差点掉到地上。
“啊！”小小的惊呼一声，她抬头，发现撞上的竟是认识的人。“洪小姐。”
年轻女子看着她的表情充满嫌恶。
“天阔哥在哪间病房？”
“503。”
问出想要的答案，洪小琦连一句话也不打算跟她多说的扭头就走。
乔若曦却突然扬声叫住她，“洪小姐，等等好吗？”
“干么？”虽然语气不悦，但她还是停下了脚步。
“可不可以请你顺便把这锅鸡汤带去给他喝？”
洪小琦扬起眉。“你在玩什么把戏？干么不自己送去？”
乔若曦难过的低下头。“他不肯见我，我们分手了。”
一听这话，洪小琦的脸都亮了起来。“真的？”
“嗯。所以这鸡汤可不可以麻烦你，就说是你自己炖的。别说是我……我怕他知道以后不高兴。”
低着头的乔若曦一副柔柔弱弱的样子，让洪小琦看了就不高兴。人家天阔哥根本就不想见你了，还傻傻的炖什么鸡汤，真是笨蛋！
content_en:
"Hey, sister-in-law, don't think so much. Come on, give me a few. I'll tell you the quantity tomorrow and go get it myself." Afeng snatched the flyer from her hand. "Give me the rest and I'll send it to you."
"Ah——"
However, before Qiao Ruoxi finished speaking, Afeng had taken all the flyers away.
"Sister-in-law, I will call you tomorrow morning." After saying that, he waved his hand and Afeng left quickly.
"Boss, lunch."
Chu Tiankuo glanced at the lunch box brought by A Feng indifferently. For him now, eating is just to fill his stomach.
I used to have the feeling of looking forward to someone’s appearance at noon every day, with happiness
Maybe it really was a dream, and what he thought he had didn't actually exist.
Now I just wake up and go back to my old life.
"Boss, this is our first time ordering this bento! You can tell whether it tastes good or not."
Afon's talkativeness made him frown. "Whatever, don't bother me with such trivial matters."
"Uh...yes."
Chu Tiankuo’s face is
With this arrangement and the color of the vegetables, who else would put grilled steak as the main course in a bento that costs seventy or eighty yuan at most?
"Boss, how's it going? Do you still like it?"
Chu Tiankuo's face changed suddenly, he raised his head and asked sharply: "What's going on?"
"Sister-in-law—er, I mean Miss Qiao. I met her at the bank that day. She said that she is now starting a lunch business. I want to say help her..."
Chu Tiankuo gritted his teeth and said nothing.
His downcast look looked scary, and he couldn't guess his thoughts for a moment. Ah Feng could only shrink his neck and said: "I'm sorry, boss, if you are unhappy, I will not order lunch from her again."
"No!" Chu Tiankuo yelled immediately, then felt that he had overreacted, calmed down for a moment, then pursed his lips and said: "You should still order with her, but don't buy my share in the future."
"Boss, you don't like it?"
"Instigation!" he roared again.
"Yes." Afeng secretly glanced at Chu Tiankuo. The boss seems to care about his sister-in-law very much! I don't know what the quarrel between the two of them is.
"Boss, please take it easy, I'm out." He left immediately.
Chu Tiankuo was left alone in the office. Looking at the tempting bento in front of him, he couldn't help but pick up the steak and took a bite to chew. Afeng suspected that he didn't like it, how could he not like it. It tasted so good that it made him upset.
The next second, he cursed, pushed away the chair and stood up.
Enough! He should stop thinking about her!
There's nothing a man can't let go of, except a woman who doesn't love him.
Turning away from looking at the bento, he left the office and strode into the construction site. Now he had to do something to keep himself busy, so busy that his brain automatically shut down.
"Boss! Be careful!"
He heard someone yelling in panic, but by the time Chu Tiankuo came to his senses, it was already too late. With his head spinning, he failed to see the road ahead clearly, and fell into the two-story basement.
"Boss!"
Several brothers and workers rushed in his direction.
Chu Tiankuo felt severe pain all over his body, his chest felt like it was blocked by a huge boulder, and he could not open his mouth. Damn it! I have been working on the construction site for so long, how could I make such a mistake?
"Boss! How are you?"
"We're calling an ambulance!"
"Hey, don't move, boss! You can't move with broken bones!"
There was a lot of noise beside him. Chu Tiankuo gritted his teeth and endured the bursts of pain. The thought of him having to show such cowardice in front of his men made him sick to death.
Just because of a woman, he seemed to have lost his soul. It was enough!
The ambulance came, and just the effort of moving him to the stretcher made him sweat. The blood loss made him dizzy.
"By the way, I have to inform my sister-in-law quickly!" Someone suddenly shouted loudly.
"No -"
Gritting one's teeth and exhausting one's whole bodyAfter having the strength to say these words, Chu Tiankuo was sent to the ambulance.
Qiao Ruoxi, who rushed to the hospital after receiving the news, almost collapsed to the ground when she saw Chu Tiankuo being pushed out of the operating room with his eyes tightly closed.
The fracture and multiple contusions on her left hand were considered a blessing among misfortunes, but when she saw the circles of bandages on his bed, she still couldn't stop her tears from flowing out.
It must be painful, right?
Her hands trembled as she touched his bandage, and her heart ached.
Although his tall body was lying on the hospital bed, he did not look weak at all. The angular face and dark skin were familiar to her but she hadn't seen them in a long time.
Although she really wanted to stay by his side, keep looking at him and accompanying him, Qiao Ruoxi didn't want to be in this situation!
Suddenly, the person on the bed frowned, and then opened his eyes.
"You're awake! Great! How do you feel now?"
Chu Tiankuo narrowed his eyes and looked at Qiao Ruoxi in front of him. Her red and swollen eyes and nose showed that she had just cried, and her anxious and sad look made him subconsciously want to put her in his arms to comfort her and tell her that it was okay.
However, when he came back to his senses, he remembered that they were over.
He forcefully suppressed the hand he wanted to raise. "What are you doing here?"
"I..." Qiao Ruoxi blinked tears.
"Please leave."
"You were injured and just had an operation. I want to take care of you."
"No, you go." He said coldly.
Is this her reward again? She used to be his girlfriend, but now she takes care of him who is injured. He had had enough of this kind of repayment.
He doesn't want it at all.
"But..."
"I told you to leave!"
Her whole heart was broken when he yelled at her like that. "Um...I'm sorry, take care of yourself."
With her head lowered and tears that she didn't want him to see, Qiao Ruoxi walked out of the ward in embarrassment.
Behind her, Chu Tiankuo had a gloomy look on his face.
Qiao Ruoxi was holding a thermos pot in her hand, which contained the chicken soup she had stewed since she got up early in the morning. This bowl of soup is not easy to make. You have to pay attention to the heat and filter out impurities and excess oil from time to time.
Chicken soup should be very helpful to the patient. She was only thinking about this, but she didn't think about how she should give it to him.
She hurriedly arrived at the hospital at almost eleven o'clock, but was blocked from the ward door.
"Sister-in-law, I'm sorry."
Seeing Afon's apologetic expression, her heart sank. "I just wanted to give him some chicken soup."
Afeng scratched his head, still only smiled bitterly.
She bit her lower lip. "Then...can you bring it to him for me? He just had an operation and should supplement some nutrition. I've been simmering this chicken soup for a long time."
After hearing her words, A Feng's face was full of embarrassment.
"Sister-in-law, you'd better go back. The boss is injured now and has a bad temper, so it's better to obey him. Don't worry, I will take good care of the boss."
Qiao Ruoxi lowered her head.
She knew that what A Feng said made sense, and that he actually didn't need her to take care of him, but she just wanted to see him and try her best...
She didn't expect that his resistance to her would be so deep.
"Yeah."
Reluctantly forcing a smile on Afeng, she turned around in frustration and returned holding the heavier thermos bottle.
Chapter 8(2)
As she walked towards the elevator, she heard the crisp sound of high heels on the floor, then her shoulder bumped into someone, and the thermos bottle in her hand almost fell to the ground.
"Ah!" Xiao Xiao exclaimed. She looked up and found that she bumped into someone she knew. "Miss Hong."
The young woman looked at her with an expression full of disgust.
"Which ward is Brother Tiankuo in?"
"503."
After asking for the answer she wanted, Hong Xiaoqi turned around and left without even intending to say a word to her.
Qiao Ruoxi suddenly called out to her, "Miss Hong, wait a minute, okay?"
"What?" Although her tone was unhappy, she still stopped.
"Can you please take this pot of chicken soup with you?Give him a drink? "
Hong Xiaoqi raised his eyebrows. "What tricks are you playing? Why don't you send it yourself? "
Qiao Ruoxi lowered her head sadly. “He refused to see me and we broke up. "
Upon hearing this, Hong Xiaoqi's face lit up. "Really? "
"Um. So can I trouble you to make this chicken soup? Just say that you stewed it yourself. Don't say it's me... I'm afraid he'll be unhappy if he finds out. "
Qiao Ruoxi, who had her head lowered, looked soft and weak, which made Hong Xiaoqi unhappy. Brother Tiankuo doesn't want to see you at all, and he's stupidly making chicken soup. What a fool!
